items.headline: Man City defeat leaves United struggling in derby, questions Carrick's start
items.summary: Manchester United lost 1-0 to Manchester City despite having 10-man advantage for 60+ minutes after Phil Foden's early red card.

items.headline: United's poor start: one win in four, eight points behind Arsenal and City
items.summary: After derby defeat, United have won only one of four Premier League matches without a clean sheet and conceded seven goals.

items.headline: Carrick faces Brighton in Carabao Cup after derby defeat; expected to rotate squad
items.summary: Manchester United host Brighton in Carabao Cup third round on 16 September with Carrick likely to rotate after Manchester City loss.

items.headline: Brighton beat United 3-0 in May; history suggests high-scoring fixture ahead
items.summary: Brighton defeated United 3-0 in May 2026, with previous three meetings all high-scoring. United won most recent at Old Trafford 4-2.

items.headline: Grimsby Town eliminated United last season; early EFL Cup exit would pile on pressure
items.summary: United lost to fourth-tier Grimsby Town in second round last season and cannot afford another early Carabao Cup exit.
